notes: Posting of stock transactions to GL / AR / AP: port of the program units of ST_POSTING_CPOSTING.fmb (SET_POST_ENTRIES, MAKE_ENTRY, SET_POST_CUSTOMER, SET_POST_SUPPLIER ...) in app_proc_st.post_trns; regression-tested by cancel + re-post of 160 real 2026 transactions (GL vouchers identical).

proc.description_a: ترحيل حركات المخازن (فواتير المبيعات والمشتريات ومرتجعاتها والتحويلات والتسويات) للأنظمة الأخرى: الحسابات العامة (قيد لكل حركة حسب ربط الحسابات بنوع الحركة STACLNK)، العملاء (حركة عميل في AR_MAINTRNS) والموردين (حركة مورد في VN_MAINTRNS). حدد الفترة ونطاق أنواع الحركات (ويمكن تحديد مسلسل الحركة والعملاء والمندوبين) ثم اختر الأنظمة المطلوبة. لا تُرحل الحركات الواقعة في فترة مقفلة، والحركات التي بها خطأ في الربط لا تُرحل وتظهر رسالتها في الجدول أدناه.
proc.description_e: Post stock transactions (sales and purchase invoices and returns, transfers, adjustments) to the other systems: GL (one voucher per transaction from the account links of the transaction type, STACLNK), AR (customer transaction in AR_MAINTRNS) and AP (supplier transaction in VN_MAINTRNS). Choose the period and the range of transaction types (optionally serials, customers, salesmen) and the systems. Transactions in a closed period are refused; transactions with link errors are skipped and their message is listed below.

params.name: FROM_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.join_type, 1) <> 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by t.trns_type_code

params.name: TO_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.join_type, 1) <> 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by t.trns_type_code desc

params.name: FROM_CUSTOMER
params.lov_sql: select c.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(c.name_e, c.name_a), c.name_a) d, c.code r from customer c where nvl(c.customer_status, 0) = 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or c.code in (select cp.customer_code from ar_cust_password cp where cp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by c.code

params.name: TO_CUSTOMER
params.lov_sql: select c.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(c.name_e, c.name_a), c.name_a) d, c.code r from customer c where nvl(c.customer_status, 0) = 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or c.code in (select cp.customer_code from ar_cust_password cp where cp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by c.code desc

params.name: FROM_SALESMAN
params.lov_sql: select s.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.code r from salesman s where (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or s.code in (select sp.salesman_code from ar_salesman_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by s.code

params.name: TO_SALESMAN
params.lov_sql: select s.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.code r from salesman s where (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or s.code in (select sp.salesman_code from ar_salesman_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by s.code desc

proc.confirm_a: هل تريد ترحيل حركات المخازن المحددة للأنظمة المختارة؟
proc.success_a: انتهت عملية الترحيل - راجع رسائل الحركات التي لم ترحل في الجدول
proc.preview_sql: select m.trns_type_code, decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) type_desc, m.trns_serial, m.trns_date, m.doc_no, m.store_code, coalesce(m.customer_code, m.supplier_code) partner_code, nvl(m.post_flag, 0) gl_posted, case when t.join_type = 3 then nvl(m.cust_post_flag, 0) end ar_posted, case when t.join_type = 4 then nvl(m.supp_post_flag, 0) end ap_posted, case when m.ac_entry_no is not null then m.ac_entry_year || '/' || m.ac_entry_type || '/' || m.ac_entry_no end gl_entry, (select listagg(p.message, ' | ') within group (order by p.message) from st_post_msg p where p.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and p.trns_serial = m.trns_serial) post_message from st_trns_mast m join st_trns_type t on t.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code where nvl(m.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and t.join_type in (2, 3, 4) and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or m.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and m.trns_date between nvl(to_date(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_DATE'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), trunc(sysdate, 'YYYY')) and nvl(to_date(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_DATE'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), sysdate) and m.trns_type_code between nvl(to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_TYPE')), 0) and nvl(to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_TYPE')), 999999999999) and (v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_SERIAL') is null or m.trns_serial >= to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_SERIAL'))) and (v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_SERIAL') is null or m.trns_serial <= to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_SERIAL'))) and (nvl(m.post_flag, 0) = 0 or (t.join_type = 3 and nvl(m.cust_post_flag, 0) = 0) or (t.join_type = 4 and nvl(m.supp_post_flag, 0) = 0) or exists (select 1 from st_post_msg p where p.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and p.trns_serial = m.trns_serial)) order by m.trns_type_code, m.trns_serial
